title: Document reusable Infinigen world quality recipe
objective: Document the reusable recipe we should follow for future generated worlds, based on the cafeteria v1 failure modes and cafeteria v2 improvements, including the new scene light dimming launch control.
instructions: Add a concise reusable recipe/checklist to docs/importing_and_exporting_assets.md for generated Infinigen worlds intended for active illumination research.

Recipe must cover: real wall openings/windows with exterior context, actual Unreal light actors added post-import rather than relying on Blender lights, neutral/desaturated material palette with texture/material import enabled, correct furniture orientation, auto-generated collision or explicit collision plan, manageable scene complexity/export resolution, validation report with mesh/light counts and bounds, cook/package validation, and live flashlight validation.

Record launch-time lighting balance: use --scene-light-intensity-scale to dim existing scene lights without disabling them, use --indirect-lighting-intensity 0 for the co-located flashlight in small scenes, and tune flashlight intensity/radius/cones per world.
Update .control-tower/docs/state/current-status.md with the new scene-light scale control and the fact that a reusable generated-world recipe now exists. Do not create commits.

artifacts: examples/flashlight/run.py and examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py now expose --scene-light-intensity-scale, defaulting to 1.0, to scale existing scene light intensities at launch before spawning the co-located flashlight. Use finite non-negative values; 0.0 dims scene lights to off without using --disable-scene-lights.

expected_outputs: Files changed and summary of recipe additions.
definition_of_done: Future Tower/Experimenter runs have a durable recipe to follow for generated worlds and current status references it.
